title: Luminaires - General Requirements and Tests
scope: General safety and performance requirements for electric luminaires including street lights and outdoor lighting fixtures.

title: LED Luminaires for General Lighting Purposes
scope: Specifies performance requirements for LED luminaires including LED street lights, efficacy, and photometric performance.

title: Luminaires - Particular Requirements - Street Lighting Luminaires
scope: Specific safety and construction requirements applicable to street lighting luminaires used outdoors.

title: Electric Luminaires - General Safety Requirements
scope: Electrical safety requirements for luminaires, including insulation, live parts protection, and voltage handling.

title: Classification of Degrees of Protection Provided by Enclosures of Electrical Equipment (IP Code)
scope: Defines ingress protection ratings such as IP66 for dust and water resistance of electrical enclosures.

title: Industrial Safety Helmets - Specification
scope: Specification for industrial safety helmets used for head protection at construction sites, including impact resistance, penetration resistance, and material requirements.

title: Industrial Safety Helmets - Method of Test
scope: Test methods for evaluating impact resistance, penetration resistance, and electrical insulation of industrial safety helmets.

title: Mild Steel Tubes - Specification
scope: Specification for mild steel tubes and pipes used for water distribution, structural, and general engineering purposes.

title: Electrically Welded Steel Pipes for Water and Sewage
scope: Specification for large diameter electrically welded steel pipes used for water and sewage transportation, including pressure testing requirements.
